messages:
Mia (ML Eng): Heads up, onboarding smoke failed for gargoyle-6b — chat sessions getting weird truncation and token bleed when sliding_window is enabled.
Ashok (Infra): :eyes: saw the CI logs, looks like a config mismatch during HF->Redwood conversion. Any config.json snippet?
Mia (ML Eng): Pasting the converted config we used:
```json
{
  "model_type": "gargoyle",
  "max_position_embeddings": 2048,
  "num_key_value_heads": 32,
  "rope_scaling": {"type": "linear", "factor": 1.2},
  "sliding_window": true,
  "chat_template": "chatml"
}
```
Mia (ML Eng): The hf repo had sliding_window implied by chat template but tokenizer special tokens differ (chat start/end map to two tokens instead of one).
Devon (Serving): That double-token marker will shift KV cache indexing by +1 each turn if sliding_window expects single-token markers — off-by-one in cache -> early truncation.
Linda (Eval): eval-bot run produced big quality regressions on multi-turn benchmarks, especially re-asking for context after turn 3. I ran a small repro: `rw-convert --from hf --model gargoyle-6b --check-config` returns: 
```
WARN: tokenizer.special_tokens: <|chat_start|> -> [50256, 314] (2 tokens)
WARN: sliding_window=true but chat_template mapped markers != 1 token
INFO: suggested change: either set sliding_window=false or normalize special tokens to single token
```
Ashok (Infra): Options: 1) normalize tokenizer to single-marker (preferred), 2) force sliding_window=false for this model, 3) post-conversion patch to shift kv-head alignment at runtime. Each has tradeoffs for latency/compat.
Mia (ML Eng): Quick preference poll: Linda/Ashok? I can try token remap + quick eval.
Linda (Eval): Remap first, run 100-convo smoke. If perf/regression still present, toggle sliding_window in staging and measure tokens/sec delta.
Devon (Serving): FYI rope_scaling factor 1.2 also changed our extrapolated rotary mapping; combined with offset it amplifies attention phase misalignment in long chats. Keep an eye on head count mapping too (num_key_value_heads vs num_attention_heads mismatch can silently degrade KV layout).
Mia (ML Eng): I'll push a remap patch to tokenizer and re-run quant smoke. Leaving notes in the onboarding PR. @eval-bot can you queue a 100-convo run after the patch? :thumbsup:
eval-bot: Queued: gargoyle-6b-remap-100convo (priority: medium). Will post results when done.
Ashok (Infra): Thanks — also logging this as a config-interop wrinkle for onboarding checklist (SLIDING_WINDOW vs chat_template vs special tokens vs rope_scaling).
Mia (ML Eng): Great, will report back with metrics.
